name: Stacked Emphasis Slam
easing: line1/3 slide: EASE.out f0-14 / f18-32; big word: spring pop f10+; burst strokes f14-24, fade f24-34
bestFor: 'It's not X, it's Y' / one keyword that must land hard.
notSuitable: Sentences >25 chars on the big line.
keyframeTable: top line sliding in from left
top line in place; big word slams in at 1.7x scale
big word at ~1.1x, burst strokes drawing
burst fading, bottom line sliding in from right
script: Top line slides in from the left; big orange word slams in from 1.7x with a spring; ten short burst strokes radiate around it then fade; bottom line slides in from the right.
colorRules: Big word orange; burst + lines cream.
